summary: Tested Omaha8 evaluator: 11/11 backend pytest cases passed (validation, logic, health). Frontend loaded, auto-evaluated default hand (A-S 2-H 5-C K-D => L4+H1+F1-R1=5, Playable), popover card change triggered re-evaluation (updated to L4+H2+F2-R0=8, Raise/Build), duplicate-suit prevention works, evaluate/reset buttons and all status pills, metric cards, scoop and teaching panels render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports MongoDB (motor) and connects on import but app is stateless per spec - MongoDB is unused; consider removing to reduce surface area.
POST /evaluate wraps evaluate_hand in try/except and re-raises as 400 - fine, but Pydantic ValidationError is already handled by FastAPI as 422 so this is only for runtime bugs.
CardSelector: when rank is changed such that current suit becomes duplicate, the card auto-updates without validation guard; validateHand still catches it and disables Evaluate, so acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_evaluate.py covers validation + spot-check logic. Frontend uses data-testid throughout; auto-evaluate is 250ms debounced.
